channel.title: Pawan Thiruverkadu · Reports
channel.description: Analysis of the services industry and energy markets by Pawan Thiruverkadu, applying the quantitative toolkit of energy economics.

item.title: Labor as a Growth Limiter for Service-Based Businesses
item.description: In HVACR services, labor is the product, and it is getting more expensive and harder to find. Why the firms that last will build their technicians instead of recruiting them.

item.title: The Dynamic Impact of Feed-in-Tariffs on Solar Capacity
item.description: Did China’s 2013 solar subsidies actually move investment, and how fast? A dynamic spatial regression discontinuity study along the Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Inner Mongolia border.

item.title: The Economics of the U.S. Cattle Industry
item.description: A group report from my first year at Texas A&M, following cattle from ranch to retail through demand, supply, macroeconomics, trade, and environmental costs.
